provenance.observations: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A (Element84 Earth Search) / Sentinel-1 RTC (Planetary Computer), 2025
provenance.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025; BRP © RVO/PDOK
provenance.scope: 1847 silage/grain maize parcels in 3 held-out test regions of south-east Netherlands (Limburg south & north, Gelderland east). Not national coverage; regions were chosen where grain maize occurs.
provenance.labels: Farmer-declared crop use (BRP codes 259 snijmais / 316 korrelmais), kept separate; used only for evaluation.

model.name: rf_s2_s1
model.note: Random Forest trained on 4243 field-seasons (2024+2025) in other regions; tuned and calibrated on validation regions; these test regions were never used for training or tuning.

evaluation.split: Fixed spatial split by region (same every year): train = Limburg-mid, Peel, Kempen; val = NE Brabant, Echt; test = Limburg-south, Limburg-north, Gelderland-east. Training years: 2024+2025; test year: 2025

comparison.label: RF · S2+S1, data to Oct 31 only

latency.note: Inference on the lab workstation CPU (64 cores) from cached features; excludes Sentinel retrieval.

gap.note: SIMULATED: real clear looks removed from test fields
